'''Field inspector''' was a position held by some [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The field inspectors were among the only Thyferran Humans to not live within [[Xucphra City|Zalxuc City]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
